name: Chorus Call
description: Call a low chorus note and hear which ally's soul answers late or weak.

name: Chorus Lift
description: Raise one voice of a chorus above the rest so an ally's weak technique is carried by the group.

name: Low Anchor
description: Sink a low anchor note into the soul so a hostile push cannot drag the user off pitch.

name: Clean Voice
description: Run a clean voice along an ally's chipped soul until the edges smooth and close.

name: Sharp Entry
description: Enter on a sharp note against an opponent's soul so they flinch from the sound of their own thoughts.

name: Chorus Swell
description: Swell the voices of several allies together so each soul technique among them runs clearer and stronger.

name: Static Clear
description: Sing out the hum of a hostile soul tone clinging to an ally until their own clear note returns.

name: Shared Tone
description: Share one held tone between two souls so a tired ally draws on the steadier hold of the user.

name: Tone Survey
description: Send a quiet tone through a company and map which souls ring clear and which ring dull.

name: Tone Veil
description: Draw a veil of even tone around the user that softens the edge of a hostile soul strike.

name: Gentle Overtone
description: Add a gentle overtone to an ally's weak soul note until the note holds its own.

name: Open Fifth
description: Sound an open fifth beside an ally to widen the room their soul technique has to work in.

name: Sour Note
description: Throw a sour note into an opponent's soul so their focus sags and their casting sours.

name: Tone Link
description: Join two allies with a bridge of held tone so soul technique passes between them with little loss.

name: Clear Tone
description: Clear a muddied soul tone in an ally by sounding the plain true note the muddle has hidden.

name: Discord Sense
description: Hear where two allied souls grate against each other and name the pitch where they part.

name: Easing Interval
description: Soften a harsh interval between two souls by shifting the user's note to sit between them.

name: Damped String
description: Press a finger on a ringing string of soul force so a hostile tone dies before it spreads.

name: Cross Beat
description: Strike two clashing beats into an opponent's soul so no single rhythm holds in their casting.

name: Discord Mend
description: Draw the clash out of two allies who have been jarred apart by a hostile soul tone.

name: Resolving Step
description: Lead a sour chord of allied souls into the sweet one that follows so their combined work steadies.

name: Cadence Mark
description: Mark the closing beat of an ally's soul technique so the user knows when it will end.

name: Cadence Hold
description: Hold the closing beat a moment longer so the ally's soul work finishes whole.

name: Cadence Rest
description: Rest the soul of a strained ally on a long closing note until the strain drains away.

name: Closing Ward
description: Close each beat with a soft ward so no hostile tone slips into the gap between beats.

name: Lead Voice
description: Take the lead voice of the group so allies find their entries without a word spoken.

name: Cadence Break
description: Break an opponent's cadence with a stab of soul force so their technique stops mid-phrase.

name: Held Cadence
description: Hold the cadence for a whole company so every ally finishes their soul technique with steady power.

name: Resolved Phrase
description: Resolve a hanging soul phrase left by a hostile technique and free the ally it had caught.

name: Echoed Refrain
description: Repeat an ally's soul technique a beat later in the same pitch so the second blow follows the first.

name: Joined Voice
description: Join the soul voice of the user to one ally so that the two sound as one stronger voice.

name: Voice Weigh
description: Weigh how loud each ally's soul speaks to see who carries the group and who trails.

name: Voice Knitting
description: Pour two voices at once over a wearied ally so the soul fills back to its proper depth.

name: Voice Shield
description: Raise a wall of many voices at one pitch to hold off a hostile soul push.

name: Voice Lift
description: Lift an ally's flagging soul voice with a rising note of the user's own.

name: Voice Spike
description: Drive a narrow spike of voice into an opponent's soul so their next thought breaks off.

name: Voices Abreast
description: Line up three voices in one phrase so the combined soul work runs deeper than any alone.

name: Voice Rinse
description: Rinse a hostile whisper out of an ally's soul with a warm line of plain voice.
